name: profile_length_increases
invariant: L(H . e) = L(H) + 1 for every admissible event e (COMPLEXITY.md section 2). This should be the first regression check on any implementation of the derived profile function.
explanation: Trivial but foundational: since History is append-only and every admitted event contributes exactly one entry, event length must increase by exactly one per admitted event regardless of event kind (pop/refuse/bind/collapse).
